title: Windgram site input, repository sites.json

slug.description: Lowercase hyphenated slug — the identity of models and sites everywhere.

what3words.description: what3words address of the launch ("word.word.word", no leading slashes) — a human-readable echo for pilots. latitude/longitude is the operative identity; the string is opaque (validation would need the proprietary what3words API).

timeZone.description: The site's IANA timezone (e.g. "America/Vancouver") — required. Local time is load-bearing for reading a windgram, and builders echo it per-profile as the optional site.timeZone.

items.description: One hand-authored launch: identity only. Elevation is deliberately absent — the pipeline derives it from lidar (see site-context.json); a human types nothing about the physical world but where it is.

description: Repository sites.json — the hand-authored site input: identity only (slug, name, coordinates, optional what3words, timezone). The pipeline derives elevation and publishes the complete record at the dataset root.
